issue.title: Taxonomic hierarchy incorrect for certain cases

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug, but the fixed code broke 14 previously passing tests across the parsing, BIOM-creation and sample-processing suites, and parse_tax_lvl raises NameError: name 're' is not defined on a plain Chlorophyta entry. Check first whether the fix is missing an `import re`, which would likely explain both Break My Fix findings and the regressions, then re-run the suite.
